home.hero_text: Saffron, Taif rose, oud and soft musk, blended into modern perfumes that last from the first coffee to the last guest.
home.woody_text: Oud, vetiver, saffron and amber for evenings, weddings and cooler nights.
home.bright_text: Black cherry, rose and vanilla for every day, from the office to the weekend.
home.story_title: Old Arabian notes, worn the modern way
home.story_text: Misk is musk and mirr is myrrh, two of the oldest scents of Arabia. We pair them with fresh fruit, flowers and woods so they feel at home in a city day as much as at a majlis.
home.story_point_1: Rich concentrations that last through the day
home.story_point_2: Every bottle gift wrapped, with a handwritten card
home.story_point_3: Free delivery across the UAE on orders over AED 300
home.gift_title: For Eid, weddings and every "just because"
home.gift_text: The Daydream Trio brings three of our lightest perfumes together in one box: Blossom Love, Sweet Dream and Bliss Aqua.
